taun.label: taun
taun.description: This is the minority carrier lifetime for electrons.  It represents the average time that an electron will diffuse in p-type material before recombining with a hole.

taup.label: taup
taup.description: This is the minority carrier lifetime for holes.  It represents the average time that a hole will diffuse in n-type material before recombining with an electron.

i_len.label: i_len
i_len.description: Physical length of the intrinsic region (zero doping).

i_node.label: i_node
i_node.description: Number of plotted points along the length of the intrinsic (zero doping) region. Only valid when intrinsic region length is not zero.

n_node.label: n_node
n_node.description: Number of plotted points along the length of the N-type material. Increase number of nodes at high doping for better accuracy.

p_node.label: p_node
p_node.description: Number of plotted points along the length of the P-type material. Increase number of nodes at high doping for better accuracy

vn_step.label: vn_step
vn_step.description: Set the number data points sampled in the voltage sweep.

impurity.label: impurity
impurity.description: Here you define if any impurity doping level exists in the intrinsic region.

materialp.label: materialp
materialp.description: Set the type of material used for the entire region.

temperature.label: temperature
temperature.description: This is the temperature in the environment around the device.

vsweep_high.label: vsweep_high
vsweep_high.description: Set an applied voltage across the PIN Junction.  For IV characteristics, the voltage will sweep from 0V (ground) to the applied voltage.

impuritylevel.label: impuritylevel
impuritylevel.description: Unintentional doping in the intrinsic region.

impuritydoping.label: impuritydoping
impuritydoping.description: Here you define type of doping for in the intrinsic region

Efn.label: Efn
Efn.description: quasi Fermi level for electrons at equilibrium

Efp.label: Efp
Efp.description: quasi Fermi level for holes at equilibrium
